# VibeRaven

> Agent production layer for AI-built apps. Mission Map + Production Protocol.

Canonical agent command:

```bash
npx -y viberaven --agent-mode
```

Preview the native chat/terminal flow locally:

```bash
npx -y viberaven preview --agent-mode
```

Install agent rules into this repo or any repo:

```bash
npx -y viberaven init --agents all
npx -y viberaven doctor --agents
```
